edit.description: Delete the per-key-path `EntryShape` fabrication in `collection_address_from_row` (the `else` arm at 941-961, which hardwires `hooks.<Event>` -> group-array(HOOK_HANDLER_KEY;HOOK_MATCHER_KEY), `enabledPlugins.*` -> scalar("enabled"), and both `object` shapes). Lift `entry_shape` through `kind_vocab`/`entry_shape_from_label` with no fallback. The three cited provider constants at 223/231/236 stay where they are; the duplicate mapping is what goes.

`CollectionAddressRow::entry_shape` (4525-4546) becomes `String` and sheds `#[serde(default)]`, joining `manifest`/`key_path` as a required column: `collection_address_table` (5583) always writes it, `collection_address_from_table` (5596) reads it with `req_str`, and both doc headers lose the optional-presence wording.

The re-blessed ts-rs binding — `entry_shape: string` in place of `string | null`. Regenerate with `BLESS_SEAM_BINDINGS=1`, never by hand. `sdk/src/declarations.ts`'s `collectionAddressRow` (372) needs no edit: `CollectionAddress.entryShape` is already a required `string` (`sdk/src/kind.ts:162`), so the narrowed binding typechecks as written.

Retire `shapeless_hook_kind_facts` (112) with its call site in the round-trip fixture (1660) and the shapeless-row assertions it feeds (1734-1755); keep `timed_hook_kind_facts`'s divergent-shape round-trip, which is the column's real oracle. Add the refusal: a committed lock whose `collection_address` inline table omits `entry_shape` fails the row read loud.

`collides_at_hooks_event` (848) takes `entry_shape: &str` instead of `Option<&str>` and drops the `map(str::to_string)` at 856; the `custom_hook` call site (886) declares `group-array(hooks;matcher)` like its colliding twin. The collision under test is the address pair, so any declared shape serves — the two rows then diverge only on name, which the helper's doc comment already claims. This path is the one the first build attempt bailed on.
The explain-a-registration-kind fixture at 1526 declares `group-array(hooks;matcher)` instead of `entry_shape: None`.
The shared hook kind-facts builder at 1227 sheds its `Some(...)` wrapper. Construction-site only — no signature moves, so no importer of the helper changes.
Three collection-address constructions (1046, 1419, 1427) shed their `Some(...)` wrappers.

summary: A collection address's entry shape becomes a required lock column — `src/kind.rs` stops fabricating one per key path, a second home for shapes the provider face declares.

tests.asserts: a `collection_address` inline table omitting `entry_shape` refuses at the row read instead of normalizing to its key path's shape, and a declared shape diverging from its key path (`group-array(hooks;matcher,timeout)`) still round-trips through emit and the lift
the committed `CollectionAddressRow` binding byte-matches a fresh ts-rs export after the column goes total

acceptance: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` green with the fabrication deleted and the re-blessed binding committed; `rg 'EntryShape::' src/kind.rs` shows no per-key-path mapping left outside `entry_shape_from_label`.
notes: Only a hand-built payload can omit the column: `sdk/src/kind.ts:162` makes `entryShape` required, and every collection row in `src/builtin_lock.toml` and `.temper/lock.toml` carries it. A stale external lock now refuses rather than normalizing — pre-1.0 (`specs/distribution.md`, "Versioning"), so the commit body carries a `BREAKING:` line. scoped at aac7eedf
